terms.definition: Any living thing, made of cells, that carries out the activities of life.
terms.function: The basic living unit of ecology.
terms.whyItMatters: All ecosystems are built from organisms.

terms.definition: The smallest unit of life that organisms are built from.
terms.function: Carries out the basic activities of life.
terms.whyItMatters: Cells are the building blocks of all life.

terms.definition: The things living things do: grow, use energy, respond, and reproduce.
